sloka: एते ते शैल राजस्य सुते लोक नमस्कृते ।गंगा च सरिताम् श्रेष्ठा उमादेवी च राघव ॥१-३५-२२॥
transliteration: ete te śaila rājasya sute loka namaskṛte ।gaṁgā ca saritām śreṣṭhā umādevī ca rāghava ॥1-35-22॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus Ganga, the holiest of rivers and Uma devi are two daughters of the king of the mountains, (Himavan). They are worshipped by the entire world.
